title: Slovakian Fried Dumplings
description: A traditional Slovakian dish made with fried dough balls served with a side of dumplings.
instructions: Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Fry the dough disks until they are golden brown and puffed up.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fried dough from the oil and place it on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fried dough with dumplings on the side.
Dust the fried dough with fried for extra crunch.
